The sites reopen September 5, and a photo‑comment activity runs through September 13, offering limited‑edition utensil sets or picnic mats as prizes.
body:
The Harbor Bureau said the restoration of Sanjiaoji and Fugui Cape lighthouses is finished, with Sanjiaoji receiving barrier‑free facilities and toilet upgrades, and Fugui Cape gaining safer trails and roof waterproofing. title: KMT Purchases All 15,000 Mooncake Boxes from Disability Sheltered Workshops After Presidential Office Cancels Order
summary: After the Presidential Office cancelled its planned purchase of about 15,000 mooncake boxes from Taiwan’s disability sheltered workshops due to budget issues, KMT chair Zheng Li‑wen announced the party would buy the entire order, ensuring the workshops receive the sales and preventing the loss of income for disabled workers.
body:
After the Presidential Office cancelled its planned purchase of about 15,000 mooncake boxes from Taiwan’s disability sheltered workshops due to budget issues, KMT chair Zheng Li‑wen announced the party would buy the entire order, ensuring the workshops receive the sales and preventing the loss of income for disabled workers.

title: ‘Football saved Dad’s life’: meet the coach of the England women’s Parkinson’s team
summary:
It began with getting her dad into walking football after his diagnosis – now Gemma Darvill is taking a national team on tour to Canada
When Gemma Darvill’s dad, Les, was diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease aged 58, joining a walking football team stopped him from confining himself to his own home, and she believes the game saved his life.
What she could never have foreseen was that, eight years later, she would find herself coaching the first England women’s Parkinson’s team, helping transform the lives of women with the disease from all across the country. She is set to embark on a journey to Toronto to help spread awareness of the ways in which walking football can help put the brakes on the progression of Parkinson’s symptoms.
 Continue reading...

title: Applications Open Now! Government Increases Subsidy to NT$180,000 Annually, No Means Test, Retroactive Claims Allowed
summary: The Ministry of Health and Welfare announced the 2026 "Residential Service Institution Users Subsidy Program" upgrade, increasing the monthly subsidy for moderate to severe disability to NT$15,000, up to NT$180,000 per year, retroactive from January this year. The subsidy uses a "monthly accrual" mechanism; eligibility requires residency of at least half the month, greatly shortening payout time. Additionally, persons with disabilities can apply for an extra NT$5,000 monthly subsidy without switching tracks, enjoying more continuous support. The program opened applications on September 14; residents need to bring ID and residency contract to the local city/county government of the institution. The Executive Yuan instructed streamlining review to ensure residents of nursing homes and long-term care facilities receive financial assistance quickly, alleviating the heavy burden of long-term care.
body:
The Ministry of Health and Welfare announced the 2026 "Residential Service Institution Users Subsidy Program" upgrade, increasing the monthly subsidy for moderate to severe disability to NT$15,000, up to NT$180,000 per year, retroactive from January this year. The subsidy uses a "monthly accrual" mechanism; eligibility requires residency of at least half the month, greatly shortening payout time. Additionally, persons with disabilities can apply for an extra NT$5,000 monthly subsidy without switching tracks, enjoying more continuous support. The program opened applications on September 14; residents need to bring ID and residency contract to the local city/county government of the institution. The Executive Yuan instructed streamlining review to ensure residents of nursing homes and long-term care facilities receive financial assistance quickly, alleviating the heavy burden of long-term care.

Read more from the original source: [Yahoo Entertainment](https://tw.news.yahoo.com/%E4%BB%8A%E8%B5%B7%E9%96%8B%E6%94%BE%E7%94%B3%E8%AB%8B-%E6%94%BF%E5%BA%9C%E8%A3%9C%E5%8A%A9%E5%8A%A0%E7%A2%BC-%E5%B9%B4%E7%99%BC18%E8%90%AC-%E4%B8%8D%E6%8E%92%E5%AF%8C-%E5%8F%AF%E8%BF%BD%E6%BA%AF%E8%AB%8B%E9%A0%98-091800315.html)

title: The girl with a will to live: the love, hope and pain of raising Elsie – my one in 163 million daughter
summary:
She was born with an ultra-rare genetic disorder. After my decades working in film PR, I now face the biggest campaign of all: the fight for her life
My daughter Elsie has beautiful curls – blond like a little Botticelli cherub’s, hair that someone dark like me could only ever dream of. She laughs a lot, has a cheeky sense of humour and soaks in all the sounds around her – rustling leaves, the sea, a dog barking, children playing around a pool, me impersonating the alarm clock every morning, me impersonating monkeys. Indeed, me impersonating any animal.
Sound is important for Elsie because she has a visual impairment and, while we know she has some peripheral vision, is legally classed as blind. As a result, she uses her tongue to check her environment. When she’s excited it sticks out, tasting the air around her, licking anyone close, sensing space. And when she likes the taste of something she keeps her tongue out until you give her more. This is how we know she likes lollies.

body:
She was born with an ultra-rare genetic disorder. After my decades working in film PR, I now face the biggest campaign of all: the fight for her life
My daughter Elsie has beautiful curls – blond like a little Botticelli cherub’s, hair that someone dark like me could only ever dream of. She laughs a lot, has a cheeky sense of humour and soaks in all the sounds around her – rustling leaves, the sea, a dog barking, children playing around a pool, me impersonating the alarm clock every morning, me impersonating monkeys. Indeed, me impersonating any animal.
Sound is important for Elsie because she has a visual impairment and, while we know she has some peripheral vision, is legally classed as blind. As a result, she uses her tongue to check her environment. When she’s excited it sticks out, tasting the air around her, licking anyone close, sensing space. And when she likes the taste of something she keeps her tongue out until you give her more. This is how we know she likes lollies.

[Britain] is leading, along with Nato allies, the push back against Russia’s dangerous and reckless campaign against us.

title: Monthly subsidy for users of long-term care residential facilities increased by NT$5,000
summary: Long-term Care 3.0 strengthens support for moderate to severe care and family support. For moderate to severe disabled persons residing in residential care facilities, a monthly subsidy increase of NT$5,000 is retroactive from January 1 this year, with a maximum annual amount of NT$180,000. At the same time, the subsidy for residential care expenses for persons with disabilities is also increased by NT$5,000 per month, applications accepted immediately. If eligible for subsidy last year and continue to reside in the same residential service institution this year with unchanged subsidy eligibility, only supplementary documents are needed, no reapplication required. The Ministry of Health and Welfare said the 'Residential Service Facility Users Subsidy Program' for fiscal year 115 now accepts public applications. To streamline administration, cases that were approved for subsidy in fiscal year 114 and continue to reside in the same residential service institution this year with unchanged eligibility in principle do not need to reapply.
body:
Long-term Care 3.0 strengthens support for moderate to severe care and family support. For moderate to severe disabled persons residing in residential care facilities, a monthly subsidy increase of NT$5,000 is retroactive from January 1 this year, with a maximum annual amount of NT$180,000. At the same time, the subsidy for residential care expenses for persons with disabilities is also increased by NT$5,000 per month, applications accepted immediately. If eligible for subsidy last year and continue to reside in the same residential service institution this year with unchanged subsidy eligibility, only supplementary documents are needed, no reapplication required. The Ministry of Health and Welfare said the 'Residential Service Facility Users Subsidy Program' for fiscal year 115 now accepts public applications. To streamline administration, cases that were approved for subsidy in fiscal year 114 and continue to reside in the same residential service institution this year with unchanged eligibility in principle do not need to reapply.

title: Shun Ren Brothers Association Purchases Sheltered Workshop Mooncakes for Donation to Disadvantaged Organizations
summary: With the Mid-Autumn Festival approaching, to convey social warmth and support caring for disadvantaged groups by people with disabilities, the Shun Ren Brothers Association held a 'Mid-Autumn Charity Donation for the Disadvantaged' event on the 15th at the first floor Chuan Hall of the Taichung City Council. The association specially purchased 360 boxes of Mid-Autumn mooncake gift sets from the Eden Foundation's sheltered workshop and donated them to Taichung home-care children and disability welfare organizations, demonstrating double love (see photo), allowing disadvantaged groups to feel warm hospitality before the festival. The event was lively and warm; Taichung City Deputy Mayor Cheng Zhao-xin and Social Affairs Bureau Director Liu Jing-zhi personally attended, expressing the Taichung City Government's strong affirmation and support for this good deed. Deputy Mayor Cheng said, 'Government resources are limited, but civil society is infinite; thank you Shun Ren Brothers Association for long-term involvement in public welfare, leveraging the influence of enterprises and social groups...'
body:
With the Mid-Autumn Festival approaching, to convey social warmth and support caring for disadvantaged groups by people with disabilities, the Shun Ren Brothers Association held a 'Mid-Autumn Charity Donation for the Disadvantaged' event on the 15th at the first floor Chuan Hall of the Taichung City Council. The association specially purchased 360 boxes of Mid-Autumn mooncake gift sets from the Eden Foundation's sheltered workshop and donated them to Taichung home-care children and disability welfare organizations, demonstrating double love (see photo), allowing disadvantaged groups to feel warm hospitality before the festival. The event was lively and warm; Taichung City Deputy Mayor Cheng Zhao-xin and Social Affairs Bureau Director Liu Jing-zhi personally attended, expressing the Taichung City Government's strong affirmation and support for this good deed. Deputy Mayor Cheng said, 'Government resources are limited, but civil society is infinite; thank you Shun Ren Brothers Association for long-term involvement in public welfare, leveraging the influence of enterprises and social groups...'

title: Old House Longevity Subsidy Now Open for Applications! Changhua Allocates NT$63.74 Million for Old House Repairs, Up to 65% Subsidy
summary: Changhua County's old house longevity subsidy started accepting applications on September 16. The Changhua County Government, in line with the Ministry of the Interior's 'Old House Longevity Function Renewal Plan', has allocated about NT$63.74 million in subsidies this year, targeting legal houses over 30 years old. Eligible applicants include 4-6 story apartments or townhouses up to six stories, provided they have completed a building structural safety assessment. Applicants may receive up to 65% of construction costs under the regulations, aiming to improve the safety and living functions of old houses through repairs, allowing them to continue serving their value. The Changhua County Government's Construction Office said the application period runs from September 16 to December 15, lasting three months. Subsidy items include roof waterproofing, exterior wall repairs, pipeline updates, and barrier-free environment improvements.
body:
Changhua County's old house longevity subsidy started accepting applications on September 16. The Changhua County Government, in line with the Ministry of the Interior's 'Old House Longevity Function Renewal Plan', has allocated about NT$63.74 million in subsidies this year, targeting legal houses over 30 years old. Eligible applicants include 4-6 story apartments or townhouses up to six stories, provided they have completed a building structural safety assessment. Applicants may receive up to 65% of construction costs under the regulations, aiming to improve the safety and living functions of old houses through repairs, allowing them to continue serving their value. The Changhua County Government's Construction Office said the application period runs from September 16 to December 15, lasting three months. Subsidy items include roof waterproofing, exterior wall repairs, pipeline updates, and barrier-free environment improvements.

title: UK politics: Burnham says budget will be ‘challenging’ and denies he is just ‘tax and spend socialist’ – as it happened
summary:
PM responds to criticism from former Bank of England chief economist
Wes Streeting, the defence secretary, has posted this on social media ahead of Andy Burnham’s meeting with the Nato secretary general Mark Rutte later.
Today I am reminded of the words of my Labour predecessor Denis Healey:
“Once we cut defence expenditure to the extent where our security is imperilled, we have no houses, we have no hospitals, we have no schools. We have a heap of cinders.”
[Britain] is leading, along with Nato allies, the push back against Russia’s dangerous and reckless campaign against us.
Collectively we will continue to strengthen our ability to deter and defend all allies, against any threat. Nato will not be intimidated by Russia’s campaign of hostile actions. Russia wants to stop us helping Ukraine – but their actions will only lead us to do more for Ukraine. Russia’s actions are a sign of weakness, and a symptom of Putin’s failure in Ukraine.
To stay transatlantic, Nato is becoming more European. A Nato with Europe, and Canada, spending more, producing more, and doing more for their security. This is the idea of Nato 3.0.
Building for the future. A stronger Europe, in a stronger Nato.

body:

title: Spain Passes Major Disability and Dependency Law Reforms
summary: The Spanish Confederation IMPULSA IGUALDAD welcomes the definitive approval of reforms to the General Law on the Rights of People with Disabilities and the Law on Personal Autonomy and Care for People in Situations of Dependence. The new legislation strengthens rights-based approaches, enhances personal assistance, reduces administrative barriers, and consolidates universal accessibility as a legal right. However, the organization calls for the restoration of vetoed amendments, including tax equivalence between certain dependency and disability levels, reduced VAT for architectural barrier removal, and improved funding for the dependency system.

However, the organization calls for the restoration of vetoed amendments, including tax equivalence between certain dependency and disability levels, reduced VAT for architectural barrier removal, and improved funding for the dependency system.

title: CERMI Demands Civil Normality and Support for People with Disabilities in Ceuta
summary: The CERMI Movement has called for the restoration of civil normality in Ceuta following recent disruptions that impacted people with disabilities. Officials reported material damage to facilities, suspension of accessible transport routes, and delays in essential services and home assistance. CERMI requested specific economic and psychosocial measures to ensure service continuity and highlighted administrative delays in recognizing disabilities, particularly for those with Asperger's syndrome.
body:
The CERMI Movement has called for the restoration of civil normality in Ceuta following recent disruptions that impacted people with disabilities.
